features:
- Ho tro tu dong nhan dien & kich hoat Magisk Built-in Zygisk khi khong cai Zygisk Next
- Dinh tuyen ADB theo TransportId chong xung dot cung serial va tu dong reconnect thiet bi offline
- Bo dem tham chieu da luong DeferBroadcastForSoftReboot va cho su/SELinux san sang sau Soft Reboot
- Toi uu cache 30s RootEnvAdapter va pre-compiled Regex log UI giam tai CPU Phone Farm
- Dong nhat nap runtime DLL tu Resources/runtime va tu dong don sach file thua goc
